name: decision-record
summary: Write down a design system decision and, above all, the alternative that was rejected and why.

when: a non-obvious decision was made and will be re-litigated
an exception to the system was granted
someone asks why something is the way it is and nobody knows

steps: State the decision in one sentence, in the present tense, as a rule someone can follow.
Give the context that FORCED it. A decision with no constraint reads as a preference and gets overturned by the next preference.
Record what was rejected and why. This is the whole value of the record: the next person will have the rejected idea again, and without this they will implement it.
Name the consequences you accepted, including the bad ones.
Date it and say what would make it worth revisiting.
output: Decision, context, rejected alternatives with reasons, consequences, date, and the trigger to revisit.
done: at least one rejected alternative is recorded with its reason
the consequences include a cost, not only benefits
